front.title: Domain Name System (DNS) Public Key Based Request and Transaction Authentication (SIGZERO, SIG(0))

abstract.t: This document specifies the SIGZERO and SIG(0) Domain Name System (DNS) Resource Records (RRs) which provide public key based authentication of DNS requests and transactions. SIGZERO is the RECOMMENDED option. This document obsoletes RFC 2931 and updates RFC 6891.
